newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks edge down at close.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks edge down at close.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended down 1.28 points to 6511.43 on Friday, dragged lower by weaker golds, which slid 2.82 percent.
* Nine of 14 sub-groups fell, with 88.4 million shares traded.
Toronto stocks fell slightly on Friday as quarterly triple-witching -- the expiry of futures, options, and options on futures -- kept trading volatile, traders said.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index fell 1.28 points to 6511.43 in brisk dealings of 88.4 million shares worth C$1.43 billion.
Nine of Toronto's 14 sub-indexes rose, but weakness was driven by a sharp drop in the gold sector, which fell 2.82 percent. Gold futures prices on Comex fell US$3 an ounce for August contracts.
